blocks.text: A CRM workspace for care agents, with each subscriber's plans, usage, bills and tickets on one screen, and AI Agent Assist beside them.
A branded **self-service portal** where subscribers sign up, pay, change plans and solve problems on their own.
A **white-label** iOS and Android app under your brand, connected to the same account data.
A dealer app for sign-up, SIM activation, top-ups and payments in the field.

sections.h2: Customer experience management, from first contact to renewal

items: **Discover and buy:** subscribers choose and pay for plans online, in the app or with a dealer
**Use and manage:** balances, usage and bills are visible in every channel, in real time
**Get help:** the AI Customer Assistant answers first. A care agent takes over with the full history
**Stay:** offers and renewals reach the right subscriber at the right moment

sections.h2: Built on your live BSS data

blocks.text: Every channel reads from the same billing and charging data, and the same network data. A plan changed in the app shows in the CRM at once. A payment made with a dealer clears the balance everywhere.

items.q: What is customer experience management in telecom?
items.a: It is how an operator manages every interaction with a subscriber, across care, self-service, retail and digital channels, so service is consistent and problems are solved quickly.

items.q: Can subscribers use our brand in the portal and app?
items.a: Yes. Selfcare Now and its app (both in beta) carry your brand, colors and domain.

items.q: Do these products need Alepo's BSS?
items.a: They work best with it, and they also connect to other billing systems through open APIs.

blocks.text: Tell us how your subscribers reach you today. We'll show you the product on a case like yours.
